content: Maŋ-ŋaŋuŋ kerisieinebi me komeru sibiriganimiŋ.

Damaŋ oo akoŋ goineji waperu Yesu sundu iŋi ojibi maneya, “Galili ŋiŋigo goineji Jerusalem soriŋgo boji rigabi gawana Pailotji miko mamari siŋaŋpuineji oo roperu yabebi komebi dariyaŋuŋ wakiru lama bulmakao dariyaŋuŋke jijibu peya.”
Oŋu mibi bokirieru iŋi yajiya, “Ŋoŋo ore eru iŋi egu manesunimiŋ: Galili ŋiŋigo yoŋoji Galili ŋiŋigo goine sosowo yadureru agiburaŋ eru gobuŋ ore joiserereŋ oi manebuŋ.
Oŋu matayoŋ, nonji iŋi ŋajibe maneniŋ: Ŋoŋo maŋ-ŋaŋuŋ so kerisienimiŋ ine, ŋoŋo sosowoji oŋuakoŋ sibiriga forenimiŋ.
Me kae tinaine Siloam oo pi joroine moji waki keru ŋiŋigo 18 kema yabeme komebuŋ, ŋoŋo yoŋore iŋi egu manesunimiŋ: Yoŋoji Jerusalem kufufuŋ goine sosowo yadureru agiburaŋ eru buŋoyaŋuŋke gobuŋ.
Matayoŋ, nonji iŋi ŋajibe maneinebi: Ŋoŋo maŋ-ŋaŋuŋ so kerisienimiŋ ine, ŋoŋo sosowoji oŋuakoŋ sibiriga forenimiŋ.” Oŋu.
Gudere yo gipeinere soso buŋo
Yesuji soso buŋo mo iŋi miya, “Ŋi moji gudere yo sariko gioineo waperu dimako ore foriine baaiŋ ore rayayoŋ, mo so bofukeya.

So bofukeru gio siŋaŋinere miya, ‘Mane, nonji gudere yo yoore foriine gosa yokaomore so wareru baaboŋyoŋ, mo so bofukeboŋ. Ore eru oi wamore jikigaru morende jiji omaine egu poreiŋ. Ore eru oi keku bokende raine.’

Rauineji oŋu miyayoŋ, siŋanji bokirieru ojiko maneya, ‘O ŋi siŋaŋne, oi soine bokende gosa yo moke dimaine. Nonji damaŋ botuineo yoo oo kijuji moreŋ sikeku bogboreru sonjoŋ ruaru roregabe jijiineke fukeiŋ.
Nonji oŋu ebe gosa ŋadiineo ore foriine soine fukena. Oi so fukeiŋ ine, oi soine keigoŋ.’” Oŋu.
Yesuji Sabat kombaŋgo ŋigo mo bobiaŋgaya.
Yesuji Sabat kombaŋgo oŋgawowosi pi mogo roperu Biŋe buŋo qaji yareya.
Oo ŋigo mo ŋeya. Gemoji gosa 18 ore so bakaigame ŋadiine kasigako poretiŋgaiŋgo embimbiŋgaru ŋeku goya.
Yesuji ŋigo oi ŋoneru oŋga teme wareko iŋi ojiya, “Ŋigo, isotaki jibegoji boke guko fiine fukege.”
Oŋu miku meine qoruineo ruame oo akoŋ poretiŋgaru Anutu miteŋ gaya.

Miteŋ gayayoŋ, Yesuji Sabat kombaŋgo ŋigo oi bobiaŋgaya, oŋgawowosi pire siŋanji oi ŋoneru ore eru mane sembeako buŋo fuŋgaru ŋiŋigo kubu yoŋore miya, “Gio bobore damaŋ 6 pega, oo soine wareru bobiaŋ ŋabeiŋ ore miinebi. Oi Sabat kombaŋgo mata.”

Oŋu miyayoŋ, Ofonji bokirieru iŋi miya, “O maŋkekerisiere sasaki ŋiŋigo, ŋoŋo sosowo bulmakao ŋiine me doŋgiŋaŋuŋ oi Sabat kombaŋgo pigone pirueru oga yabebi obuo raru noegobi me mata? Ŋoŋoreone moji oi so sabare yabeega.
Maneniŋ! Ŋigo yoji Abrahamde osigida fukeko Satanji kipeme gosa 18:de so goko nonji nigiŋine oi Sabat kombaŋgo piruebe ŋoŋoreo sagaga me mata?”
Oŋu miko kisopuine sosowo yoŋoji mimiyaŋuŋ manebuŋ eru ŋiŋigo kubu sosowo yoŋoji mosi qoqowirie qembibiineke baya, oi sosowo ŋone mane eru jeriebuŋ. Oŋu.
Yojuŋ korunde soso buŋo
Yesuji soso buŋo mo iŋi miya, “Anuture qorumande fuŋne oi uruŋu? Oi wamoyago so kenobo?
Oi yojuŋ korunde so iŋi fukega: Ŋi moji oi roru gioineo raru sariko pakere sogueru yo fukeya. Yo fukeko sowo webo yoŋoji youyaŋuŋ yo ore tieŋineo ruabuŋ.” Oŋu.
Yistre soso buŋo
Yesuji moke soso buŋo mo iŋi miya, “Anuture qorumaŋ oi wamo yake so kenobo?
Oi yist rombuŋ me flaua bobosoguere so iŋi fukega: Ŋigo moji ‘Poroŋ rigabemiŋ,’ miku yist roru flaua jambe yokaomo oo qodureru babokiri eru ruame ŋeku sosowo sogueya.” Oŋu.
Mendi goŋgoŋineo janjaŋbumbuŋ oderu ropeinebi.
Yesuji raru taoŋine taoŋine eru kaeine kaeine oo Biŋe buŋo qaji yareru raru goku Jerusalem sitio oobe raya.
Rako moji iŋi weu teya, “Ofoŋ, maŋyaŋuŋ kerisiebi Anutuji munaŋ qa yareko qowirienimiŋ, oi ŋiŋigo afaine me uruŋu?” Weu teko iŋi yajiya,
“Ŋoŋo mendi goŋgoŋineo ropeiŋgo janjaŋbumbuŋ oderu jogbasasanaŋ einebi. Nonji iŋi ŋajibe maneniŋ: Ŋiŋigo kokoineji Anuture qorumaŋ maŋgo ropeiŋ ore esoiganimiŋyoŋ, oi embimbiŋganimiŋ.

Jiki pi rauineji pakereru mendi keko ŋoŋo damaŋ oo fuŋgaru sakibe dimaku mendigo qaku iŋi minimiŋ, ‘Ofoŋ, go mendi ro nore.’ Oŋu mibi bokirieru iŋi ŋajiiŋ, ‘Noŋ so mane ŋabego. Ŋoŋo urone, oi so manego.’
Oŋu ŋajiko ŋoŋo oo akoŋ fuŋgaru iŋi minimiŋ, ‘Niŋoji goke aŋibaŋi ŋeku uqo nobeŋ. Goji roregaru niŋore kae jiŋoo Biŋe qaji noremeŋ.’
Oŋu minimiŋyoŋ, iŋoji buŋo iŋi ŋajiiŋ, ‘Ŋoŋo urone, noŋ so mane ŋabego. Ore eru iŋi ŋajibe maneniŋ: Sembene bobo sosowo, ŋoŋo boke nuru useniŋ.’

“Usebi oo Abraham, Aisak, Jeikob eru kajeqouŋ ŋiŋigo sosowo yoŋoji Anuture qorumaŋ maŋgo dimabi ŋone yabenimiŋyoŋ, ŋoŋo-ŋaŋe igo ŋabebi sakibe dimanimiŋ. Fuŋneŋaŋuŋ oŋu bofukeru kuyo jojoraru ŋiraŋ-ŋaŋuŋ kibi qame gonimiŋ.
Ŋiŋigoine ŋiŋigoine yoŋo wegi wawapeineone eru rarakaineone eru mobemobe Not Saut oone wareru Anuture qorumaŋgo roperu ŋeŋeyaŋuŋ roru uqo munjaŋ noku jeribari eru gonimiŋ.
Oŋu gonimiŋyoŋ, maneniŋ! Tatariine yoŋoreone goineji fuŋfuŋgaine fukenimiŋ eru fuŋfuŋgaine yoŋoreone goineji tatariine fukenimiŋ.” Oŋu.
Kiŋ Herodji qoro goŋine ore so fukega.
Damaŋ oo akoŋ Farisi (Kadi buŋore yameŋyameŋ) goineji Yesureo wareru iŋi mibuŋ, “Kiŋ Herodji qokome guiŋgo manega. Ore eru go moreŋ yo bokeru raigoŋ.”

Mibi iŋi bokirie yareya, “Ŋoŋo gomende qoro goŋine oi iŋi mibi maneine, ‘Mane! Nonji muŋambe eru yogo gemo yobe yabebemiŋ eru jibe ŋiŋigo bobiaŋ yaberu gobemiŋ. Rabemiŋ, fureme oo roperu gione bomukubemiŋ.’

“Kajeqouŋ ŋiŋigo boakoŋ oi Jerusalem sitio yabebi komebuŋ. Moreŋ goineo so jikigaru yabebi komeegobi, ore kamakamasi peme ŋonego. Ore eru nonji muŋambe eru yogo yunekoŋ kadi raru gobemiŋ. Jerusalem ropebe nubi komebemiŋ ine, yoŋore eeboboyaŋuŋ oi jikigaru enimiŋ.” Oŋu.
Yesuji Jerusalem sitire kuyoya.

Yesuji miya, “O Jerusalem Jerusalem, ŋoŋo kajeqouŋ ŋiŋigo yabebi komebi Anutuji ŋiŋigo sore yabeme ŋoŋoreo wareegobi, yoŋo koji yabebi komeegobi. Qoqu maŋgoineji madepuine toinere rurumaŋgo ruaru ketumaŋ yabeega, nonji ore so damaŋine damaŋine gore kufufuŋpu kepore qoju ŋabebemiŋ ore maneru goboŋyoŋ, ŋoŋo oi taki ŋabeme go wapebuŋ.

Maneniŋ! ‘Anutuji soriŋ piŋaŋuŋ ŋadi game sesuine akoŋ peiŋ.’ Oŋu peiŋyoŋ, nonji iŋi ŋajibe maneniŋ, Ŋoŋo noŋ moke so ŋone nunimiŋyoŋ, jiki damaŋ mo ware fukeme oo ŋone nuru iŋi minimiŋ, ‘Ofonde tinao ware norega, Anutuji iŋo mifia teine.’ Oŋu.”
